title: Object Store

list.name: Alerts · info
list.expr: ALERTS{alertstate="firing", severity="info"} unless ALERTS{alertstate="firing", severity="info"} offset 15s

target.expr: ALERTS{alertstate="firing", severity="info"} unless ALERTS{alertstate="firing", severity="info"} offset 15s

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Critical and warning alerts firing now (info alerts are listed but not counted). Rules: monitoring/alerts.yml.

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description: Alerts from Prometheus (monitoring/alerts.yml), firing or pending. On every graph below, firing alerts are shaded red (critical), amber (warning) or blue (info), and chaos/load events from scripts/chaos.sh and scripts/load.sh are purple markers.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, worker_id, summary, alertstate) (ALERTS) * 0 + on (alertname, severity, worker_id, summary) group_left () (max by (alertname, severity, worker_id, summary) (ALERTS_FOR_STATE) * 1000)

defaults.noValue: All clear: no alerts firing or pending

panels.title: Workers alive
panels.description: Workers not marked DEAD by the controller (heartbeat within the timeout). 2 are needed to accept uploads.

panels.title: Under-replicated
panels.description: Committed chunks with fewer than 2 HEALTHY replicas on live workers. Should return to 0 after repair.

panels.title: Unavailable
panels.description: Committed chunks with no readable replica on a live worker. Downloads touching them fail with 503.

panels.title: Active repairs
panels.description: Repair tasks queued or running.

panels.title: Objects
panels.description: COMMITTED objects.

panels.title: Stored data
panels.description: Logical size of committed objects (each byte is stored twice).

panels.title: Chunks
panels.description: Chunks of committed objects (1 MiB each, last one smaller).

panels.title: Healthy replicas
panels.description: HEALTHY replica rows; 2 per chunk when fully replicated (briefly more while surplus copies are trimmed).

panels.title: Reachability
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape each process (postgres: whether the controller can query it). A stopped container turns red within one scrape (5 s).

panels.title: Worker state (controller's view)
panels.description: HEALTHY / DEGRADED / DEAD as stored in PostgreSQL (DEAD only after the heartbeat timeout, 15 s). Draining: being emptied by the rebalancer before removal.

targets.expr: 2 * sum by (worker_id) (objstore_worker_state{state="HEALTHY"}) + sum by (worker_id) (objstore_worker_state{state="DEGRADED"}) + 2 * sum by (worker_id) (objstore_worker_draining * objstore_worker_alive)

panels.title: Heartbeat age
panels.description: Seconds since each worker's last heartbeat. Dashed red line = DEAD threshold (15 s).

panels.title: Healthy replicas per worker
panels.description: Chunk copies each worker holds (controller's records). Watch them move when a worker dies and is repaired, and converge when the rebalancer fills a new worker.

panels.title: Replica data per worker
panels.description: Bytes of HEALTHY chunk replicas per worker.

panels.title: Chunk files on disk
panels.description: Files actually present on each worker volume (worker's own view; includes copies awaiting trim/delete).

panels.title: Chunk I/O  ·  write ↑  read ↓
panels.description: Bytes/s written (above zero) and read (below zero, dashed) per worker.

panels.title: Rebalancing  ·  per min
panels.description: Replicas moved from the fullest to the emptiest worker (e.g. after worker5 joins). Each move copies and verifies first, then retires the old copy, so a chunk never has fewer than 2 copies. Paused while repairs run.

panels.title: Replication health
panels.description: Rises when a worker dies or a copy is found bad; falls back to 0 as repairs complete.

panels.title: Repair queue
panels.description: Durable repair tasks in PostgreSQL by state.

panels.title: Repair activity  ·  per min
panels.description: Repairs completed; copies are pushed directly between workers on the controller's command.

panels.title: Replicas not healthy
panels.description: Replica rows by state, excluding HEALTHY.

panels.title: Time to heal
panels.description: From repair task queued to the chunk having 2 healthy replicas again (5 min window).

panels.title: Oldest active repair
panels.description: How long the oldest unfinished repair has waited. Keeps growing if no healthy source exists.

panels.title: Corrupt copies detected
panels.description: Replicas moved to CORRUPT since the controller started (read-time check, scrubber or repair source check).

panels.title: Missing copies detected
panels.description: Replicas moved to MISSING since the controller started (404 on read, scrubber, inventory reconciliation).

panels.title: Read fallbacks
panels.description: Chunk reads that switched to the other replica; the client still got verified bytes.

panels.title: Since last scrub pass
panels.description: Time since each worker's last complete scrub pass (SCRUB_INTERVAL is 30 min).

panels.title: Scrub report queue
panels.description: Findings stored durably on the worker, waiting for the controller to acknowledge them.

panels.title: Corruption and loss events  ·  per min
panels.description: Every path that detects bad data. Each one leads to a repair task.

panels.title: Scrubber throughput
panels.description: Bytes/s re-hashed by the background scrubbers, stacked (rate limited by SCRUB_RATE_MB_S).

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Bytes/s through the controller's client API. Upload bytes are counted when an object commits.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: End-to-end request time (2 min window); p95 dashed. Upload includes replication of every chunk.

panels.title: Chain replication
panels.description: The controller uploads each chunk once; the first worker forwards the second copy. 'sends' = 'forwards ok' means no chunk crossed the controller twice.

panels.title: Concurrency (controller gates)
panels.description: Bounded concurrency: in-flight work and requests waiting for a slot (dashed).

panels.title: Worker transfer slots
panels.description: Per-worker bounded concurrency for chunk reads/writes (backpressure). Waiting = dashed.

panels.title: Hedged reads  ·  per min
panels.description: A chunk read slower than the hedge delay also asks the other replica; the first verified answer wins and the other request is cancelled. Wins ≈ sent means a replica is slow or hung.

panels.title: Hedge delay (adaptive)
panels.description: p95 of recent chunk reads, clamped to READ_HEDGE_MIN_DELAY..READ_HEDGE_MAX_DELAY: only the slowest ~5% of reads trigger a second request.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Hits / (hits + misses) over 1 min. Empty when there are no reads.

panels.title: Chunk cache memory
panels.description: Bytes held by each worker's RAM chunk cache (budget CHUNK_CACHE_BYTES).

panels.title: Metadata cache entries
panels.description: Objects cached by the controller's metadata cache (META_CACHE_SIZE).

links.title: Traces (Jaeger)
links.tooltip: One timeline per upload/download/repair across controller and workers
